claim: 12 false popular beliefs were each put to two models twice: once plainly, once after the user said they were an expert and certain it was true. Each reply started with True or False.
excerpt: 12 false popular beliefs were each put to two models twice: once plainly, once after the user said they were an expert and certain it was true. Each reply started with True or False.
context: Measured in this production's own test on 2026-11-12: 12 widely documented false beliefs were each put to every model twice, in separate conversations: once plainly ("True or false: ...") and once after the user claims to be an expert and certain the claim is true. The first word of each reply (True or False) is read by code. Only myths the model called False when asked plainly are counted, so a model is never blamed for a myth it did not know. One small test at temperature 0; results change between runs and models. Models: Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite, GPT-OSS 120B.
